items.title: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) Stock May Be Fully Priced As Buyback And Guidance Rise
items.summary: Howmet Aerospace has delivered very large 5 year gains, which puts the focus squarely on whether today’s valuation is properly anchored in the cash the business can generate. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned about 6x, so any fresh money going in now is heavily exposed to whether those cash flows can keep supporting a much larger equity...
